## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
# ::: {.panel-tabset}
# ## a) Estimador
# $E(X) = 1(\theta/4) + 2(1 - \theta/4) = 2 - \frac{\theta}{4} \implies \hat{\theta} = 4(2 - \bar{X})$

# ## b) Insesgamiento
# $E(\hat{\theta}) = 4(2 - E(\bar{X})) = 4\left(2 - \left(2 - \frac{\theta}{4}\right)\right) = \theta$ (Insesgado).

# ## c) Varianza
# $Var(X) = E(X^2) - [E(X)]^2 = \left(4 - \frac{3\theta}{4}\right) - \left(2 - \frac{\theta}{4}\right)^2 = \frac{4\theta - \theta^2}{16}$
# $Var(\hat{\theta}) = 16 \frac{Var(X)}{n} = \frac{4\theta - \theta^2}{n}$

# ## d) ECM
# $ECM(\hat{\theta}) = Var(\hat{\theta}) = \frac{4\theta - \theta^2}{n}$

# ## e) Simulación
theta_fijo <- 2

dexr1 <- function(x, theta){
  ifelse(x == 1, theta/4, ifelse(x == 2, 1 - theta/4, 0))
}

rexr1 <- function(n, theta){
  sample(c(1, 2), size = n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(theta/4, 1 - theta/4))
}

estimar_theta1 <- function(X){
  4 * (2 - mean(X))
}

df_exr1 <- data.frame(X = rexr1(1000, theta_fijo), Tipo = "Teórico")
theta_hat1 <- estimar_theta1(df_exr1$X)
df_temp1 <- data.frame(X = rexr1(1000, theta_hat1), Tipo = "Estimados")
df_exr1 <- rbind(df_exr1, df_temp1)

ggplot(df_exr1) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = X, y = after_stat(density), fill = Tipo), bins = 2, center = 1, color = "black", alpha = 0.7, position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Ejercicio 1 Discreto: Comparación de Muestras")

# ## f) Convergencia
tamano <- c(10, 50, 100, 500, 1000)
N <- 500
df_convergencia1 <- data.frame()

for (n in tamano){
  estimacion_n <- replicate(N, {
    X <- rexr1(n, theta_fijo)
    estimar_theta1(X)
  })
  df_convergencia1 <- rbind(df_convergencia1, data.frame(n = factor(n), Estimacion = estimacion_n))
}

ggplot(df_convergencia1) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = n, y = Estimacion, fill = n), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = theta_fijo, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(title = "Convergencia del Estimador (Ejercicio 1)", x = "n", y = "Estimación de θ") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")
# :::


```

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
